name: Teelon Erinsten
source:
A dragon knight who has no fear in saying what he thinks in front of other people, even nobles.
He travaled from the northern lands so he could meet Zella, but it seems he foreshadowed some events that would happen during a banquet, making his true intentions a mystery.
